review:
A sparkly cluster game with Super Cascades and Magic Frame Multipliers. Whenever there's a winning cluster, frames can appear at random during the spin or cascade, each with an adding multiplier for any cluster that passes through it.

Several frames in one cluster add together before multiplying the win, so a big cluster crossing two or three frames is the goal. Values start at 2x and climb. 10,000x max, and the gem-and-stardust art is beautiful.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
